source.book: 山海经·南山经·南次三经
source.text: 有鳥焉，其狀如雞，五采而文，名曰鳳皇，首文曰德，翼文曰義，背文曰禮，膺文曰仁，腹文曰信。是鳥也，飲食自然，自歌自舞，見則天下安寧。

inferred.item: 自然胸骨与骨盆的双足鸡形，低冠与短扇尾
inferred.basis: 鸡形直接据「其狀如雞」；具体喙长、胸腹比例、双足数与足趾、低冠、短扇尾的长度及羽层为设计补足。圆胸与短尾不违背原文；五处纹样直接顺随天然羽面，不为书写字纹把胸腹改成圆盘。

inferred.item: 朱红、青绿、赭金、米白、墨黑五采
inferred.basis: 五采而文直接见于正文；这五种颜料色、羽区位置、羽缘分色与眼喙足色均为艺术设色，原文未逐一指定五色。

inferred.item: 首德、翼义、背礼、膺仁、腹信的羽面字纹
inferred.basis: 五处位置与对应的德、义、礼、仁、信均直接据经文；将「文曰」解释成可辨的德、義、禮、仁、信书写字纹，是视觉推断，不主张复原古文字。纹样随羽面起伏，胸前仁纹与腹部信纹分开，双翼各配义纹。

inferred.item: 静立、交替缓步与展翼踏舞
inferred.basis: 自歌自舞见于原文；静立呼吸、每步的支撑节律、展翼幅度、左右先后踏步及具体清亮和鸣均为交互演绎，非古经所记步法或音高。

sourceVerification.matchingMethod: Exact continuous bird entry after balanced annotation templates are stripped from the independently downloaded raw wikitext; not a claim of an unmodified raw-byte substring.
sourceVerification.note: 南次三经丹穴之山条；正文作鳳皇，逐项核实鸡形、五采而文、首德/翼義/背禮/膺仁/腹信、自歌自舞及见则天下安宁。仅引完整鸟条，未将隔开的山名拼成连续引文；不补写不啄凡粟、雌雄区分、火焰或后世长尾。

mediumStages.reason: Four-view inspection found an incorrectly paired symmetric feather fan; excluded from final asset.

production.adaptation: New dedicated two-stage chicken body and single-wing HIGH masters, both submitted only after Read inspection of corrected normalized 34/side/front/back Medium views, 34 first, HighPack and no texture_mode surcharge. Organic breast keel, pelvis, legs and native tail retained; no disc-shaped chest adaptation. Independent HIGH wing instances have inverse-transpose authored normals and corrected winding on the offline right reflection, with no runtime negative scale. Five small virtue patterns are baked into original feather UVs, retaining the generated plumage and relief. 149816 triangles retained after fragment cleanup; 18 bones, idle/walk/alert, straight 0.12 m/s gait with rigid toe soles and grounded alternating dance. Meshopt/WebP 2048, simplify/flatten/join false.

qa.soleMethod: Three actual noncollinear deformed sole vertices per foot, actual useFrame at 60Hz, complete world XYZ, heading and sole-plane normal over every support phase

parentAcceptance.inputAudit: Five receipts, actual reference-image bytes and both 50000-triangle HIGH originals independently verified; merged ledger preserves all earlier receipts.
parentAcceptance.visualReview: Parent Read inspection of idle/walk/special, six motion closeups, front/back/both sides/three-quarter, dance and step: chicken-shaped body, natural breast/pelvis, two rooted wings, two articulated legs, short native tail and feather-surface virtue patterns; no visible stretching strands, detached wing roots or pronounced intersections in sampled frames.
parentAcceptance.lifecycle: Parent integration QA: independent cloned scene/nodes/bones/skeletons; three real unmounts each dispose 3/3 bone textures and 6/6 owned materials, clear mixer bindings, preserve shared geometry/textures and cached transforms. All three clips advance after every remount.
parentAcceptance.cardsAndAudio: 390px and 800px: no horizontal overflow; title and narration controls reachable; actual narration time advances and stops. 800px retains the existing shared-layout limitation where the text card can cover the model. Decoded narration is finite, 70.2955 seconds; synthesized call RMS measured, delayed calls cancelled on unmount.
